brand: Bible no nyinaa wɔ krataa baako so
docTitle: Bible no wɔ Asase Mfoni so · Bible no nyinaa wɔ krataa baako so
metaDesc: Di Apam Dedaw bere nhyehyɛe, Yesu nkwa, ne Paulo akwantu no akyi wɔ asase mfoni ankasa so — Bible no sii wɔ mmeae ankasa.

s.kicker: Bible no nyinaa wɔ krataa baako so · Asase Mfoni
s.title: Bible no wɔ Asase Mfoni so
s.verse: “Ɛnyɛ anansesɛm na yɛte bɛka kyerɛɛ mo wɔ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo tumi ne ba a ɔrebɛba no ho, na mmom yɛahu na yedi ne kɛseyɛ no ho adanse.” (2 Petro 1:16)
s.purpose: Bible no nyɛ anansesɛm. Ɛyɛ nnipa ankasa a wɔnantew mmeae, mmere, ne din ankasa so no ho kyerɛwtohɔ. Di saa akwan no akyi wɔ asase mfoni so, wɔ bere nhyehyɛe mu — mia baabi, anaa mia ▶ na fa anammɔn baako baako fa mu.
s.ot_kick: ① Apam Dedaw — bere no mu
s.ot_lead: Ɛnyɛ akwantu baako pɛ na mmom ogyefosɛm-abakɔsɛm no a ɛsen fi abɔde bere so: abɔde ne asehwe → nsuyiri ne Babel → ɔfrɛ (Abraham) → bɔhyɛ asase → Misraimfi tu → sare so → asasegye → ahenni → mu paee → nnommumfa → nsanba.
s.je_lead: Di Yesu nkwa akyi sɛnea Asɛmpa nhoma no ka no, wɔ nhyehyɛe mu — efi nʼawo wɔ Betlehem, fa nʼasubɔ ne Galilea som so, twa mu wɔ Samaria, kosi asɛndua, owusɔre ne ɔsorokɔ wɔ Yerusalem.
s.pa_h: Efi Antiokia kosi asase ano — Roma
s.pa_lead: Efi Pentekoste wɔ Yerusalem, sɛnea asɛmpa no trɛw fii Yudea akyi — fa Asia Ketewa ne Europa so kosi ahemman no koma mu. Yi akwantu enum no mu baako (1·2·3 + akwantu a ɛkɔ Roma + wɔgyaa no akyi) na di Asomafo nsɛm no akyi ne nkrataa a wɔkyerɛwee wɔ ɛkwan so no.
s.foot: Nnyinaso · Mmeae no di Bible asɛm ne Bible asase nimdeɛ a wɔde di dwuma no akyi (ɛne nnɛ din a ɛboa). Mpoano, nsubɔntene ne atare no, wɔtwe fii asase ho data a wɔabue (Natural Earth) mu, a wɔayɛ no mmerɛw.
s.contact: Nsɛmmisa · adwene — Fa email brɛ yɛn

eden.name: Eden (Abɔde · Asehwe)
eden.note: Wɔ wiase a wɔbɔɔ no papa yiye mu, bɔne ba mu na ɛsɛe abusuabɔ a ɛda Onyankopɔn ne nnipa ntam no.
events: Abɔde wɔ nna nsia mu — “na ɛyɛ papa yiye”
Wɔbɔɔ nnipa Onyankopɔn suban so
Asehwe no, ne tu a wotuu wɔn fii Eden
Asɛmpa bɔhyɛ a edi kan — “ɔbea no aseni bɛbɔ ɔwɔ no ti”

noah.name: Ararat (Nsuyiri no)
noah.today: Ararat Bepɔ, apuei fam Türkiye nnɛ
noah.note: Onyankopɔn bu wiase a bɔne ahyɛ no ma no atɛn, nanso ɔnam abusua baako so kora nkwa so.
events: Wiase a porɔwee ahyɛ no ma
Nsuyiri no, ne Noa adaka no
Nyankontɔn apam no — “nsuyiri remmɛsɛe wiase bio da”

babel.name: Babel Abantenten
babel.note: Ahantan a ɛpɛ sɛ edu ɔsoro no, Onyankopɔn maa wɔn kasa yɛɛ basabasa na ɔhwetee nnipa no wɔ asase so.
events: “Momma yɛnkyekyere kuro ne abantenten… na yɛnnye din”
Onyankopɔn maa wɔn kasa yɛɛ basabasa
Nnipa no hwetee wɔ asase so (Sinar — akyiri yi Babilonia)

ur.name: Ur
ur.note: Bible no ogye asɛm no fi ase wɔ ɔbarima baako frɛ mu.
events: Onyankopɔn frɛɛ Abram fii Kaldeafo Ur mu
“Mɛma wo ayɛ ɔman kɛse… ɛnam wo so na wobehyira nnipa nyinaa”
Ɛnam gyidi so ogyaa nʼasase

haran.name: Haran
haran.note: Wɔ ɛkwan so, ɔregye ɔfrɛ no so kɔ bɔhyɛ asase no so.
events: Tera abusua tenaa Haran
Tera wui
Abram sii mu kɔɔ Kanaan bere a wadi mfe 75

shechem.name: Sekem · Kanaan
shechem.note: Wɔ bɔhyɛ asase no so wɔhyɛ abusua ase na apam no kɔ awo ntoatoaso so.
events: Wɔwura Kanaan, afɔrebukyia a edi kan — “wʼasefo na mede saa asase yi bɛma”
Apam no (1 Mose 15) · Isak · Yakob
Yakob mmabarima dumien — mmusuakuw dumien no nhini

egypt.name: Misraim (Gosen)
egypt.note: Abusua bɛyɛ ɔman kɛse — afei ɔman a wɔyɛ nkoa.
events: Yosef, a wɔtɔn no, sɔre dii tumi wɔ Misraim
Yakob abusua nyinaa siane baa fam sɛ wɔredwane ɔkɔm
Israel ɔman a ɛrenyin no, wɔyɛɛ no nkoa

sinai.name: Sinai Bepɔ
sinai.note: Apam Dedaw mu ogye a ɛso sen biara — nkoa bɛyɛ Onyankopɔn ankasa nkurɔfo.
events: Ɔhaw du no ne Twam Afahyɛ oguamma no
Po Kɔkɔɔ no twae na wɔtwaa mu
Mmaransɛm Du, Mmara no, Ahyiae Ntamadan ne afɔrebɔ

kadesh.name: Kades (sare so)
kadesh.note: Gyidi a wonni ma awo ntoatoaso baako hwere asase no — nanso Onyankopɔn ne wɔn tena hɔ.
events: Akwansrafo dumien — nanso nnipa no ampene sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto Onyankopɔn so
Mfe 38 wɔ sare so — mana, omununkum ne ogya
Wɔ Moab tata so, Mose asɛnka a etwa to (5 Mose)

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: Awiei koraa no wɔwura na wɔfa bɔhyɛ asase no.
events: Yordan twae na nnipa no twaa mu
Yeriko afasu no bubui
Kanaan asasegye ne asase no a wɔkyekyɛe

shiloh.name: Silo (Atemmufo)
shiloh.note: Ɔhene nni hɔ nti, obiara yɛ nea ɔpɛ — ɔhene ankasa ho hia.
events: Wosii Ahyiae Ntamadan no wɔ Silo
Bɔne–nhyɛso–ogye mmeae a ɛsan ba no (Debora, Gideon, Samson)
Rut — nokwaredi wɔ esum nna mu, wɔ Dawid aseni mu

jerusalem.name: Yerusalem · Ahenni a Ɛyɛ Baako
jerusalem.note: Israel bere a ɛsɔ ani sen biara — ne ɔhene a ɔtim daa ho bɔhyɛ.
events: Saul ɔhene a odi kan, afei Dawid ne Goliat
Dawid apam — “wʼahengua betim daa” (2 Samuel 7)
Salomo si asɔredan no wɔ Yerusalem

samaria.name: Samaria · Ahenni a Emu Paee
samaria.note: Ahenni no mu paee na ɛsɛe bere a adiyifo no resu.
events: Salomo akyi, mu paee kɔ Yuda ne Israel
Abosonsom a ɛsan ba
Elia, Yesaia, Yeremia su ‘monsan mmra’ — na wɔhyɛ Mesia ho nkɔm

nineveh.name: Ninewe (Asiria)
nineveh.note: Wobuu kɔkɔbɔ biara animtia nti, atifi fam na edii kan hwee ase.
events: Ninewe, Asiria ahenkurow
Atifi fam ahenni no hwee ase Asiria anim (AKB 722)
Wɔsomaa Yona kɔɔ Ninewe

babylon.name: Babilonia
babylon.note: Anadwo a esum duru sen biara — nanso nsiesie ho bɔhyɛ no da so wɔ hɔ.
events: Yerusalem hwee ase, wɔhyew asɔredan no (AKB 586)
Wɔde Yuda kɔɔ Babilonia
Daniel ne Hesekiel — gyidi ne anisoadehu wɔ nnommumfa mu

susa.name: Susa (Persia)
susa.note: Abosonsom ahemman koma mu mpo, Onyankopɔn kora ne nkurɔfo so.
events: Persia di Babilonia so
Ɛster gye Yudafo fi ɔsɛe mu
Nehemia bɔ mpae wɔ ɔhene anim na wɔsoma no

return.name: Yerusalem Nsanba
return.note: Wɔsan ba na wosiesie — nanso ɔhene biara mmae. Wɔtwɛn Mesia.
events: Nsanba abiɛsa denam Kores mmara so (Serubabel 538 · Ɛsra 458 · Nehemia 444)
Wɔsan si asɔredan no na wosiesie Yerusalem afasu no
Malaki — Apam Dedaw to twa: “Mɛsoma me bɔfo”

bethlehem.name: Betlehem
bethlehem.note: Mesia a wɔhyɛɛ ne bɔ no ba Dawid kurow no mu — Asɛm no a ɛbɛyɛɛ onipa.
events: Wɔwoo no wɔ Betlehem, Dawid kurow mu
Abɔfo bɔ nnwanhwɛfo amanneɛ no
Anyansafo no ba bɛsom no

nazareth.name: Nasaret
nazareth.note: Onyankopɔn nyin sɛ onipa wɔ kurow teta bi mu.
events: Wɔtetee no wɔ duadwumfo fie
Wɔ mfe dumien mu, ɔrebisa na ɔrebua nsɛm wɔ asɔredan no mu
Akyiri yi wɔpoo no wɔ ne kurow hyiadan mu

jordan.name: Yordan Asubɔnten
jordan.today: Yordan a ɛwɔ fam no nnɛ
jordan.note: Ne badwa mu som fi ase — ɔsoro sɔ ano sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔba no.
events: Yohane bɔɔ no asu
Honhom no sian sɛ aborɔnoma — “Woyɛ me Dɔ Ba”
Odii Satan sɔhwɛ abiɛsa so wɔ sare so

cana.name: Kana
cana.note: Ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a edi kan mu na ɔdaa nʼanuonyam adi.
events: Ɔhɔho wɔ ayeforohyia ase
Nsu a ɛdanee nsa — ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a edi kan
Nʼasuafo gye no di

sychar.name: Sikar (Samaria)
sychar.note: Som a edi kan no kwan — fa Yerusalem so kosi Samaria a wobu no animtia no.
events: Ɔdwira asɔredan no wɔ Yerusalem
Anadwo, Nikodemo — “Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsan wo wo”
Nkwa nsu ma Samaria ɔbea bi

capernaum.name: Kapernaum
capernaum.note: Galilea som no dwumadibea — ɔfrɛ, ɔkyerɛkyerɛ ne ɔsɔretia nyinaa hyia wɔ ha.
events: Ɔfrɛ apopofo no na ɔde ne dwumadibea si ha
Bepɔ so Asɛnka no — “Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔhia honhom mu”
Ahenni no ho mmɛbu — ne ɔsɔretia a ɛresɔre

galilee.name: Galilea Po
galilee.note: Ɛnam tumi a ɔwɔ wɔ abɔde so so, ɔda no a ɔyɛ adi.
events: “Yɛ komm” — ɔbrɛ ahum no ase
Ɔde burodo enum ne mpataa mmienu maa nnipa 5,000 aduan
Ɔnantew nsu ani

caesarea_p.name: Kaesarea Filipi
caesarea_p.note: Asuafo no te ase sɛ ɔyɛ Kristo no, na asɛndua kwan no bue.
events: Petro gyidi no — “Wone Kristo no, Onyankopɔn a ɔte ase no Ba”
Ɔhyɛ ne wu ne owusɔre ho nkɔm kane
Wɔsesa no anuonyam mu wɔ bepɔ no so

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: Wɔ kwan a ɛforo kɔ Yerusalem no so, ɔhwehwɛ wɔn a wɔayera.
events: Ɔma onifuraefo Bartimeo hu ade
Ɔfrɛ ɔtogyefo Sakeo
“Onipa Ba no bae sɛ ɔrebɛhwehwɛ na wagye wɔn a wɔayera nkwa”

bethany.name: Betania
bethany.note: Ɔda ne tumi a ɛwɔ owu so adi wɔ ne dapɛn a etwa to no anim.
events: Ɔnyan Lasaro fii ɔda mu — “Mene owusɔre ne nkwa”
Maria sra no ngo ma ne sie
Saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi ma pɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛku no no mu yɛ den

jerusalem.name: Yerusalem
jerusalem.note: Nea Bible no nyinaa kyerɛ no awiei — asɛndua, owusɔre, ɔsorokɔ.
events: Ɔde anuonyam hyɛn mu; ɔsan tu asɔredan no apon gu
Wɔ Anwummeduan a Etwa To no, ɔhohoro asuafo no anan ho
Ɔwu wɔ asɛndua no so
Ɔsɔre da a ɛto so abiɛsa, afei ɔforo kɔ soro

antioch.name: Antiokia
antioch.note: Asɔre a wɔsoma a ɛhɔ na amanaman asɛmpa no fi ase na ɛsan ba.
events: Wɔ mpaebɔ mu, Honhom no yi Barnaba ne Saul si nkyɛn
Asɔre a wodii kan frɛɛ agyidifo ‘Kristofo’ no
Akwantu 1, 2 ne 3 no mfiase

seleucia.name: Seleukia
seleucia.note: Antiokia hyɛngyinabea — wɔtenaa hyɛn kɔɔ Kipro.

salamis.name: Salami (Kipro)
salamis.note: Gyinabea a edi kan wɔ Kipro — ɔka asɛm no wɔ hyiadan mu.

paphos.name: Pafo
paphos.note: Wɔda tumi adi tia wɔn a wɔsɔre tia asɛmpa no.
events: Wɔbɔ nkonyaayifo Elima anifurae
Amrado Sergio Paulo gye di
Ɛfi ha ‘Paulo’ di anim

perga.name: Perge
perga.note: Hyɛngyinabea wɔ Pamfilia — ɛha na Yohane Marko san kɔe.

pantioch.name: Pisidia Antiokia
pantioch.note: Asɛmpa no bue kɔ amanaman fam.
events: Nkwagye abakɔsɛm asɛnka tenten wɔ hyiadan mu
Amanaman pii ani gye na wogye asɛm no
Ɔsɔretia pam wɔn

iconium.name: Ikonion
iconium.note: Nnipa pii gye di, nanso ɔtaa hyɛ wɔn ma wɔkɔ wɔn anim.

lystra.name: Listra
lystra.note: Wobu wɔn sɛ onyame, afei wosiw wɔn abo.
events: Ɔsa ɔbarima a na ɔyɛ obubuafo fi awo mu yare
Nnipadɔm no pɛ sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn afɔre sɛ anyame
Wosiw no abo gyaa no sɛ wawu, nanso ɔsɔree

derbe.name: Derbe
derbe.note: Wɔnya asuafo pii; wɔsan wɔn akyi kɔ bɛhyɛ asɔre no den.

troas.name: Troa
troas.note: Baabi a asɛmpa no de nʼani kyerɛ Europa kane no.
events: Makedonia ɔbarima bi ho anisoadehu
“Twa bra ha bɛboa yɛn”
Wɔtwaa mu kɔɔ Europa ntɛm ara

philippi.name: Filipi
philippi.note: Europa asɔre a edi kan — asɛmpa no di nkonim wɔ afiase mpo.
events: Lidia, ntama kɔkɔɔ tɔnfo, gye di
Wɔgyaa abaawa nkɔmhyɛ akoa bi
Anadwo nnwom, asasewosow, afiasohwɛfo fie nkwagye

thess.name: Tesalonika
thess.note: Asɛm no woso kurow no na ɔsɔretia bu so.
events: Ɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ hyiadan mu Homeda abiɛsa
“Wɔn a wɔadan wiase ani abutuw no”
Wɔnam anadwo so wiaa wɔn ho fii

berea.name: Berea
berea.note: Wɔn a ‘wodi mu’ a wɔn ankasa hwehwɛɛ asɛm no mu no.
events: Wɔde anigye gyee asɛm no
Da biara wɔhwehwɛ Kyerɛwsɛm no mu sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ
Pii bɛgye dii

athens.name: Atene
athens.note: Wɔ anyansafo kurow no mu, ɔka ‘onyame a wonnim no’ no ho asɛm.
events: Kurow a ahoni ahyɛ no ma no hyɛɛ no abufuw
Wɔ Areopago, ɔka Ɔbɔade ne owusɔre ho asɛm
Wodii ne ho fɛw, nanso kakraa bi gye dii

corinth.name: Korinto
corinth.note: Ɔtena hɔ afe ne fa, na ɔbɔ asɔre wɔ kurow a porɔwee ahyɛ no ma mu.
events: Ɔne Akwila ne Priskila yɛ ntamadan
“Nsuro… efisɛ me ne wo na ɛwɔ hɔ”
Korintofo pii gye di na wɔbɔ wɔn asu

ephesus.name: Efeso
ephesus.note: Akwantu a ɛto so abiɛsa no koma — asɛm no trɛw Asia nyinaa mu.
events: Da biara ɔkyerɛkyerɛ mfe mmienu wɔ Tirano asa so
Wɔhyew nkonyaa nhoma; tumi nnwuma
Dwetɛdwumfo Demetrio hyɛ basabasayɛ ase

miletus.name: Mileto
miletus.note: Nkradi a nusu wɔ mu kyerɛ Efeso mpanyimfo no.
events: “Monhwɛ asɔre a ɔde nʼankasa mogya tɔe no”
Mpanyimfo no su, efisɛ wɔrenhu no bio

caesarea.name: Kaesarea
caesarea.note: Mfe mmienu ɔka asɛmpa no ho asɛm wɔ amradofo ne ɔhene anim.
events: Asɛnnie wɔ amradofo Felike ne Festo anim
Ne kasa a ɔyii wɔ Ɔhene Agripa anim
“Mede mʼasɛm to Kaesar anim” — wɔ kɔ Roma

jerusalem.name: Yerusalem
jerusalem.note: Wɔkyeree no wɔ asɔredan no mu, na ne kwan sɛ odeduani fi ase.
events: Nnipadɔm no kyeree no wɔ asɔredan no mu
Ɔyii ne ho ano wɔ badwa no anim
Sɛ Roma kurɔmni no, wɔde no kɔɔ Kaesarea ɔwɛn ase

myra.name: Mira
myra.note: Wɔforo Aleksandria hyɛn a ɛrekɔ Roma.

fairhaven.name: Hyɛn Gyinabea Pa (Kreta)
fairhaven.note: Paulo kɔkɔbɔ sɛ wɔnnyae hyɛnkɔ no, wɔantie.

crete.name: Kreta
crete.note: Ne gyae akyi, supɔ a ɔgyaa Tito wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔnsiesie asɔre no.
events: Ɔgyaa Tito hɔ sɛ ɔnsi mpanyimfo wɔ kurow biara mu
Ɔfrɛ akannifo a wɔn ho nni asɛm na wodi nokware
Ɔkyerɛw krataa no kɔmaa Tito

malta.name: Malta
malta.note: Ɛnam ahum ne hyɛn a ɛbɔe mu, Onyankopɔn bɔhyɛ no tim.
events: ‘Apuei atifi mframa’ no bɔ hyɛn no, nanso nnipa 276 nyinaa nyaa nkwa
Ɔwɔ bi kaa no, nanso biribiara anyɛ no
Ɔsaa supɔ no so ayarefo yare

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.note: Wɔsi Italia na anuanom hyiaa wɔn.

rome.name: Roma
rome.note: Asɛmpa no du ahemman no koma mu awiei koraa — ɛnyɛ awiei na mmom mfiase.
events: Mfe mmienu ɔwɔ fie ɔwɛn ase, ɔde akokoduru ka Ahenni no ho asɛm
Ɛfi ha ɔkyerɛw Afiase Nkrataa no (Efe·Fil·Kol·Flm)
Akyiri yi wɔde no too afiase bio, ɔkyerɛw 2 Timoteo na wokum no — “Mako ako pa no, mawie mmirikakan no”

journeys.j5: Akwantu a ɛto so enum · wɔgyaa no akyi
